tagline: 理光取景器相机，1960 年发布
description: 理光于1960年推出的取景器相机。配备Riken Ricoh 40mm 1:2.8 (3 element in 3 groups)。快门速度Seikosha 500 Series - 1/25-1/160 + B (user manual speed specification). Note: this spec., conflicts with information on Ricoh's website, which quotes a shutter speed range of 1/30-1/400 plus B.。Fixed-focus 5 feet (2.5 meters) to infinity.。
